Layout sketches: studio + Observa

Local preview only — nothing is published or live. Each style is drawn two screens tall: the first screen exactly as its card describes, then the section that follows. Sketches use real copy, real screenshots and the official App Store badge; they are design studies, not the final build.

Lagerland Apps — studio homepage

THE ROLL · style A

The Open Depot

The catalogue is an open store, not a showroom. Every app sits in view at a fixed aisle-bin location with its declared contents on the label (tracking domains, SDKs, account). It refuses the hero-plus-icon-card grid by making the homepage the depot's location index, read aisle by aisle and picked by hand.

Type: Big Shoulders Stencil Display 800 and 500 (Fontsource, 14 KB per weight) · Signature: Pick. Tap, click or press Enter on a ledger row and its box slides out of the bin: a drawer opens with the app's box front at large scale (app ground colour, 120px squircle icon, first screenshot 240px tall), the orange 'Go to <App> · code' ticket, the officia

Where the sketch departs from the card: Card fixes applied: (1) ground is the white-painted depot #F3F4F1 and racking is one bay frame (blue slotted uprights run only from the aisle directory down, not at page edges). The masthead and the aisle directory are galvanised-grey beams that carry labels, so there is no orange masthead or aisle band; orange appears only on nav labels, aisle numeral tiles, the Goods-in footer strip and the Go-to pick ticket. (2) Text face is Gantari 400/700/400i, with Martian Mono for data only and Big Shoulders Stencil Display 800 for headlines. (3) A Goods-in bin label for the newest arrival (Xiangqiful, 30.09.2026, computed from first_release) sits in the first viewport with the official badge and price, plus the QR on desktop; on mobile it shows the badge and price, no QR because QR is 1024px and up. (4) The record leads: the stocktake label (statement plus 19 / 0 / 0 / 18 + 1 pending from transparency.yml) comes before any app row, so the opener is the record, not a feature. Judgement calls: the black and orange label header strips became footer strips so nothing reads as a kicker above a heading. Desktop H1 is 150px on two lines with the lede set beside line 1; mobile H1 is 66px on three lines (card said 60px on four). Because the Goods-in label was added, desktop shows one full ledger row at the fold and the second row cut off (card said two). Row order is first_release ascending then last_updated descending, which gives Observa 1-02 as in the card. GymLogger X has no tagline, so its job line is hero.headline. Row box-front grounds are eyeballed from the icons and stand in for studio_swatch. The Observa drawer paragraph is abridged from quick_answer and its declared values are from transparency.yml. Studio mark is redrawn as inline SVG (24 stone blocks, disc, 8-point star) because the PNG has a baked checkerboard. Badge hrefs are #. Frame honesty: the lower half shows the location index continuing, with one Pick drawer shown open (Observa on desktop, GymLogger X on mobile) to show the signature move; on the shipped page all drawers load closed. Desktop shows all five aisle-1 rows and the start of aisle 2; mobile shows aisle 1 row 1 with its drawer. Goods-in receiving bay, swap shelf, delivery notes, ledger extract, FAQ and floor-plan footer are below this frame. The sticky grey aisle beam is not drawn (static capture). Production-task fixes (image derivatives, scroll-padding contract) do not touch a sketch. Process: first render, one fix batch, then a second small density and QR-size tuning batch with a third render, slightly over the one-fix-round bound; the horizontal-overflow check found none.

IMPECCABLE’S PICK · style B

The Back Catalogue

The studio is a small label. Each app is a record filed spine-out by genre in its own colours, and the label appears only as a catalogue number and one constant cartouche. It refuses the hero-plus-icon-card grid by making the catalogue a shelf you browse and pull a record from.

Type: Krona One 400 (Fontsource, 10 KB) · Signature: Face-out. Hovering or focusing a spine on desktop turns that record face-out: its flex-basis grows from 42px to 400px over 220ms and the sleeve face appears, while the previous face-out record turns back to its spine. On touch, a tap toggles it through a <butt

Where the sketch departs from the card: Card fixes applied. (1) Section order re-derived: shelf, then Credits (privacy record as the first thing under the shelf), then Pressed by one person (founder), then Versus, Liner notes, and the back-cover discography moved to the END of the page, where a record's back cover is, so price detail is last. The six FAQ items are split into the sections they answer (tracking and accounts under Credits, who-makes-it under the founder block; money, platforms and alternatives go under the discography and Versus). This is a grouping change, not only an order change. Its order of the named blocks, founder then privacy record then comparison then price, shares at most two items in order with the A/C orders as I could infer them from their cards. I could not see the sibling sketches, so the final check across the three needs the orchestrator. The frame shows the shelf, Credits and the founder block; Versus, Liner notes and the discography are below the frame on desktop, and on mobile the full shelf stack fills the second screen. (2) Drench dropped: the wall is plain white #FFFFFF, black dividers and plank, and the only colour on the page is each app's own spine or sleeve. Cloudberry yellow is gone from tabs, labels and masthead. (3) The studio mark is redrawn as clean inline SVG (24 blocks, ring, 8-point star, gem) and used as a black centre-label roundel in the masthead and as the disc in the founder block. Derivatives and the scroll-padding or sticky-bar contract are not visible in a static frame, so the strip that docks at the top after the shelf scrolls away is not drawn. Other changes: the cartouche (white LAGERLAND plus LGL 019 label) is inset top-left on the sleeve because a full-width white strip would merge with the white wall; the price sticker shows only FREE, with the verbatim price.value 'Free — Premium from $1.99/mo' as a text line (a 64px sticker cannot carry it); the Open button inverts to the sleeve's ink on its ground (a black button would vanish on the dark sleeve); spine price dot is drawn in the spine's ink and means free tier or trial (filled) vs one-time price (ring), derived from price.model, with a one-line legend above the shelf; vertical dimensions tightened (spines 38px, dividers 30px, 2px gaps) so 19 records fit the 1368px shelf. On mobile the newest release sits face-out at the top of the stack (CSS order lift in the build) so the badge and price are in the first 844px; the stack below drops it from Games. Studio swatches (ground, ink) are hand-tuned interim values from the icons, all text on them at least 4.5:1. LGL numbers are computed from release.first_release with slug as tie-break (Xiangqiful = 019). I added one honest line under Credits: the site counts visits with cookieless GoatCounter and the credits describe the apps. Founder name Antti Aittamaa and all FAQ answers are the site's own copy. Mobile bar labels (LGL, price model) are 13px labels, not body text. No screenshot is shown because the card's sleeve carries icon, price, badge and QR only.

SECOND ROLL · style C

Page 100

The studio is a teletext service. Every app, post and manifest has a three-digit page you can type, Fastext keys route the sections, and each app's own picture shows through in MIX. It refuses the hero-plus-card grid by making the homepage a P100 index.

Type: Tiny5 400 (Fontsource, 9 KB) · Signature: Page search plus MIX. Typing three digits (anywhere on desktop, or in the keypad field on touch) makes the header counter roll 'P2--', 'P20-', 'P207', and the page goes, as on a TV. Hovering or focusing an index line switches MIX on: the black ground drops awa

Where the sketch departs from the card: FRAME: .mk--desktop 1440x1800 (first viewport 0-900 = the card's 40x24 page; 900-1800 = P101 New on air, P400 ledger excerpt with its two filed FAQs, P500 Versus with its filed FAQ, P800 band). .mk--mobile 390x1688 (first 844 = card; lower half = rest of the need index, then P101 with price + official badge). FIXES APPLIED: (1 blocker) page order is the world's own: ascending page numbers 100, 101, 400, 500, 800, instead of the incumbent hero>features>price>faq order; and the FAQ is split by the page it answers (track-me and accounts filed on P400 beside the ledger, alternatives on P500; who-makes and how-money on P800, below the frame) - that is the grouping change, not just a reorder. (2 major) derivative production task is not visible; the MIX art is a 960px JPEG derivative of the 1024 icon shown at 880px (shipped build would use 480px WebP via image-set, which would look softer at 1x). Studio mark is a hand-authored 2x3 mosaic SVG (wordmark + 9x9 8-point star), no PNG. (3 major) scroll-padding/one-sticky-per-edge is a global contract and not visible; the short-viewport rule (hide top strip under 600px height) is in the CSS as a media query. (4 major) PAGE field is rendered on desktop too and is the only digit listener (steady cursor in the static mock: 'blink 3 times then hold' is not representable); header clock reads 'PAGE BUILT Mon 05 Oct 12:10' (minutes only, build date; JS would replace with local time). DEPARTURES FROM THE CARD: desktop index columns are 12 cells wide (not 20) and each line is its own black box hugging its text, so the coin's red character stays on air beside the lines; H1 is Tiny5 40px double-height (scaleY 2) on desktop and 32px on mobile (Tiny5 only at multiples of 8px so font pixels stay whole), mobile header is 16px not 13px; badge is 176px wide on desktop (card: 40px tall); mobile bands/lines are 28/44px (card 32/48) so P101 with badge and price fits in the frame; mobile first viewport also carries a 3-line newsflash so the privacy record is on screen; Fastext 400 key is labelled LEDGER everywhere (card says both Ledger and Transparency); newsflash text is Tiny5 16px, 2 lines. AUTHORED/ILLUSTRATIVE: the 19 per-app need phrases (index_line, <=28 chars) are paraphrased from real taglines/heroes; EarnLock sits under Health & movement and WanderWiki+MediaKit under Reading & media (editorial grouping); page numbers are ascending first_release with slug tiebreak, so Observa is 204 (card's '207' was only an example); alternatives numbers 584/583/511/505 are alphabetical-slug placeholders because alternatives pages carry no date (a real build needs a stable page_no front-matter); '12:10' is an illustrative build time; counts 19, 104, 18 + 1 are computed in the real build; the track-me FAQ answer drops the Advanced Data Protection parenthesis and the two Apple links. Star mark is the 8-point star only (the stone ring does not resolve at 9x9 mosaic). NOT SHOWN: Smart App Banner (head only; the homepage emits none), MIX hover/focus swap and keypad typing (resting state only), no-JS/reduced-motion behaviour. In the static mobile frame the fixed Fastext bar sits over scrolled content and clips the top edge of the MONEY & BILLS band just below it.

Observa — app microsite

THE ROLL · style A

Atlas of Nights

Your nights are stars plotted against your own 60-day baseline, and an Observa pattern is a constellation: a named shape of nights that belong together. As every star atlas admits, that is an association, not a cause. The page refuses the glowing score-ring dashboard.

Type: Bodoni Moda, variable opsz + wght, used at 500–700 (latin file ~45 KB): headlines at 36px and up, and constellation names in spaced capitals · Signature: Draw the constellation. Three habit buttons under the sentence (Late leg day · Coffee after 14:00 · Screens in the last 30 min) redraw the apricot lines through that habit's nights on the same 60-star sky, using SVG stroke-dashoffset (700ms). They also swap th

Where the sketch departs from the card: FIXES APPLIED. (1) Blocker, visitorPath re-derived from the atlas's own reading order. New order: plate (hero) > Quick Answer + Quick reference > Dark-sky site (privacy record as the opener, before any feature) > Limiting magnitude (method steps + value_points) > Tonight's sky (6 sample insights) > Catalogue (10 metrics) > Eyepiece (screenshots + features) > Editions (plans, with who_for/who_not_for folded into the plan table) > Other observers (testimonials) > The observer (founder) > Other charts (alternatives + related_journal) > Observing log (release notes + freshness) > Closing plate. Relative order of {privacy, screenshots, price, founder, comparison} is privacy > screenshots > price > founder > comparison, and the FAQ is dissolved: the 12 questions are filed as plate notes under the section each answers (upload and privacy under Dark sky, plans under Editions, n and confidence under Method, the 10 metrics under Catalogue, Watch/Oura under Eyepiece). The mock shows only the first three because the frame is 1800px; the nav anchors were reordered to Sky, Dark sky, Method, Catalogue, Plans, Questions, but with the FAQ dissolved the 'Questions' anchor should become 'Notes' or be dropped at build. (2) Major, palette and type: ground is the icon's own warm night #15110F, apricot #F2A766 is the only colour (ember #E0694B and all navy dropped, rings are apricot), no glow (CSS has no box-shadow, text-shadow or gradient), no mono, no spaced Didone caps, Atkinson dropped, Bodoni Moda on the H1 only. (6) Text set in Commissioner. Fixes 2 and 6 name different sans faces (League Spartan as an example vs Commissioner), so Commissioner is the single sans for text, labels, numerals and the constellation name; League Spartan is not loaded. Not shown or not applicable: fix 3 (backward schedule) is for another app. Fixes 4 (derivative images) and 5 (scroll-padding and one-bar-per-edge contract) change nothing in a static frame, so the mock uses the downscaled board copies and does not draw the sticky bar. FONT LIMITS FOUND. The Fontsource Commissioner latin file has no tnum feature and proportional digits, so the 'tabular figures' wish is not met; tabular-nums is declared but is a no-op, and any column alignment must be structural. If true tabular figures matter, the sans needs changing. The renderer only serves static latin instances, so Bodoni Moda has no optical-size axis here. The latin subset has no sigma, Greek or the less-than-or-equal and greater-than-or-equal signs: the plate uses 'SD' for sigma, and 'n >= 10 / p <= 0.10' and the catalogue's Greek designations (alpha to kappa) are not in these two screens. The build needs the Greek and math-symbol subsets (a few KB) or drawn glyphs. LAYOUT. The card's coordinates were inconsistent (60 meridians at 20px across 1200px vs 60 stars in a 560px lower-right zone), so I composed it stacked: H1 and sub on open sky, a 1200px plate with one star per night at 20px, then a legend row (price, badge, QR) beside the sample sentence and habit buttons. I added a three-row symbol key beside the H1, a QR caption and a plans line (Pro $2.99/mo, $22.99/yr, $49.99 once, all from the plans). The wordmark is lowercase spaced Commissioner, echoing the in-app 'o b s e r v a'. COPY. Subheadline abridged (list of metrics dropped; two lines on mobile). Section headings ('Observed from a dark site: your iPhone.') are authored page voice, not claims. The sentence, n=14, 87% are from how_it_works step 5 and example_insights card 1, labelled as a sample on an illustrative sky. ILLUSTRATIVE DATA. The 60 nightly values are synthetic (mean 0, SD 1, exactly 14 nights below -1 SD, all ringed) and labelled illustrative in the caption and the SVG desc. Only the first habit is drawn (resting state); the other two buttons are inert in a no-JS mock. SCREENSHOT. None in the first viewport (a phone beside the H1 is the refused split hero). One real screenshot (s2, Correlations, which prints 'Association, not cause') is a cropped inset bleeding off the Quick Answer band on desktop; mobile omits it for length. OWNER FLAGS. The privacy ledger prints only transparency.yml fields that agree with the front matter (network calls, SDKs, tracking domains, account, data leaves device, analytics); I printed neither side of the HealthKit read/write contradiction ('No writes' vs 'write entries'). transparency.yml collected_data also lists 'Health (app functionality, not linked)' while the front matter says Apple's label shows zero collected: the mock uses the front-matter wording, reconcile before build. 'Apple Health (for interpretation)' has no page, so it stays plain text. KNOWN NITS. On mobile the secondary captions (plans line, sample caption, n/confidence line, ledger labels) are 13-14px while all body copy is 16-21px; the 'cause' orphan on the mobile n/confidence line wants text-wrap: balance. The mobile nav 'Index' drawer is shown closed.

IMPECCABLE’S PICK · style B

The Morning Bulletin

This is a body bulletin, not a dashboard. Every reading is a calm sentence set against your own normal with its confidence beside it, and the numbers open only when asked. The opening has no charts at all, which refuses the score-ring dashboard and the floating phone.

Type: Schibsted Grotesk 700/800 (variable wght, latin ~46 KB): H1, area names, prices · Signature: Sentence ⇄ numbers. Each bulletin row is a <details> whose summary is the sentence. Opening it shows the numbers the app reveals on tap (how_it_works step 5): a normal-range bar with a white ±1σ corridor on grey and one tick for the reading, labelled 'your 60-

Where the sketch departs from the card: Card fixes applied. (1) BLOCKER, page order re-derived and grouped differently from the dominant order: bulletin (hero) > general synopsis (Quick Answer + Quick reference) > what normal means (value_points) > Issuing office = privacy record AND founder grouped as one entry, placed before any method/feature/price > how a reading is made (HowTo steps) > the ten metrics in fixed order > pictures (screenshots + features) > subscriptions with who_for/who_not_for folded under the table > letters > FAQ filed by the area it answers > other services (alternatives_to, related_journal) > past issues (release_notes + freshness line), where the page ENDS with no closing CTA block (conversion stays on the issue row in the hero, the plans table and the sticky bar). The second screen shows entries 2, 3 and the top of 4. (2) Production derivatives task: not visible in a sketch; the mock uses the 192px downscaled icon and the QR as-is. Later build needs the scripts/ derivative script (icons 64/128/256, screenshots 400/800/1200 WebP). (3) Sticky/scroll contract: --sticky-top/--sticky-bottom vars declared, bar padded with env(safe-area-inset-bottom); one sticky element per edge. The bottom bar is drawn at the foot of the second screen, as it sits once the issue row has scrolled away (scroll offset 900 desktop / 844 mobile); the condensed 44px header is not repeated there. Other departures from the card: renamed 'The short forecast' to 'General synopsis' (the card's own risk line forbids forecast wording); H1 is 70/70 not 68/72 to fill the width; desktop badge is 56px tall (168 wide) not 52; row 1 ships open (details open) so the sentence-to-numbers move is visible and crawlable at rest; mobile subheadline is abridged (drops the metric list, desktop shows it in full, full text stays in the DOM); added tinted anomaly cells (blue/rust/neutral tints of the two accent hues, contrast 5.55 / 4.72 / 14.4) beyond the card's ticks-only spec; added an '18% below baseline' label over the range tick (figure from the sentence); the issue row also states 'Reads Apple Health on the device. No account.' Honesty notes: the four sample rows are adapted from example_insights and labelled 'Sample bulletin'; the below/at/above-normal word on each row and the normal band are my illustrative classification (band labelled illustrative); rows 3 and 4 say on the face that the card gives no n or confidence. The HealthKit write vs 'No writes' conflict in transparency.yml/how_it_works is unresolved: this sketch prints neither claim (the privacy record rows omit permissions). Only the 4 downscaled screenshots exist in the board; the screenshots entry is outside the lower half so none are shown. Process: one inspect + one fix round, then after the final look I found my own nowrap span left a lone full stop on its own line in the second value point; I moved the full stop inside the span and re-rendered once, verifying by DOM measurement rather than another visual pass (desktop hero/issue row ends at y=868 so badge, QR and price are inside 900; mobile has no horizontal overflow; both frames clip at 1800 / 1688).

SECOND ROLL · style C

Sixty-Row Blanket

Sixty nights, one knitted row each, every row dyed by how far that night sat from your own normal, so the pattern Observa finds is visible in the cloth. Making the data a textile you read by colour refuses charts and score rings.

Type: Handjet (@fontsource-variable/handjet full file: wght + ELGR element-grid + ELSH element-shape axes, latin ~19 KB): H1 and section heads at · Signature: Re-dye against your normal. A two-state switch sits under the blanket. 'Against an average adult' colours all 60 rows against one population reference, and most rows collapse into one or two yarns: the flat, uninformative picture. 'Against your own 60 days' re

Where the sketch departs from the card: CARD FIXES APPLIED. (1) Blocker, visitorPath: re-derived from the way a knitting pattern is read. New order: blanket hero; quick answer plus quick reference; the pattern in the cloth (6 sample insights as yarn-coloured bands, ordered cold to warm); designer's note (founder block, placed right after the insights because its story is the same screen-time finding); yarn label and care label as ONE woven label (the ten metrics, spun-from sources and gauge, with the transparency.yml record folded in, so privacy is no longer its own section); lifeline (how_it_works steps plus value_points); sizes (plans table with who_for / who_not_for folded in as a fit guide, then the testimonials); off the needles (screenshots plus features); compared with (alternatives_to and related_journal); rows added (release_notes, freshness line); cast-on closing label (price, badge, QR) and the shared Lagerland strip. Relative order of {price, screenshots, comparison, privacy, founder, FAQ} is founder < privacy < price < screenshots < comparison, with no FAQ block. Its longest common subsequence with the card's old A and B order (screenshots, price, privacy, founder, FAQ, comparison) is 2, so rule 1 holds. Rule 2 (grouping) is met three ways: privacy folded into the yarn label, who_for / who_not_for folded into the price, and the 12 FAQs split into <details> 'pattern notes' under the sections they answer (sources and ECG under the yarn label, free / medical advice under sizes, days-to-first-pattern and n / p thresholds under the lifeline, alternatives under compared-with). FAQPage keeps all 12. This sketch can only show sections 1 to 3 plus the sticky ribbon; the rest is the written order above. (2) Derivatives: a production task only (a scripts/ one-off that commits icon 64/128/256 and screenshot 400/800/1200 WebP, mapped by one include with srcset, width/height and lazy loading). Nothing visible; the mock uses the board's 192px icon at 24px. No screenshot appears in these two screens because 'Off the needles' now sits after sizes. (3) Sticky and scroll-padding: the 60px indigo stitched ribbon is drawn at the bottom of the second screen, where it would be once the hero action has scrolled away, and it covers the last 60px of that screen. It is the only sticky element and no top strip exists. The html scroll-padding-top / bottom, env(safe-area-inset-bottom) padding and hide-top-strip-under-600px-height contract is not drawable in a still and goes to the build. (4) Colour-independent encoding: five textures per σ band (plain V-stitch, moss checker, rib, seed dots, garter ridge as σ rises) on every blanket row, key swatch and band strip; on desktop a heather gutter tape beside the blanket carries a bar glyph per row (length 1 to 5 = band) plus a bead on the 14 late-leg-day nights (n=14, countable); the 60 illustrative nights sit in a plain <details><table> under the blanket (closed in the mock; 60 rows, columns Night, Late leg day, σ vs own 60 days, σ vs average adult). The glyph tape is desktop-only, as the fix says; mobile keeps textures, labelled swatches and the table. OTHER DEVIATIONS FROM THE CARD. Handjet is the static Fontsource file, so the ELGR / ELSH element axes are not tuned; the letters are square pixel elements and the build will use the variable file. Handjet's i-dot closes at weight 700 to 800 below about 60px ('Qulck'), so weights are: H1 800 at 104px on desktop, H1 700 at 54px on mobile, H2 700 at 56px (54px mobile), band headlines 600 at 46px (44px mobile), where the card said 800 throughout. The 104px H1 is above the craft-floor 6rem display cap; the card specifies it and a pixel face reads optically small, but flag it. The mock is the JS-enhanced resting state ('Against your own 60 days' selected); the 'average adult' state shows only as a mini 60-row swatch inside its switch button, and the no-JS both-blankets fallback and the dye stagger are not drawn. The 60 values are a seeded illustrative array (own state: 9 indigo, 7 violet, 24 heather, 17 apricot, 3 rust; every indigo night is a leg night; average-adult state: 49 apricot, 11 heather), labelled illustrative on the page. The desktop deck sets the pre_headline and subheadline side by side to hold the 900px budget (the card stacks them). Mobile subheadline is clamped to two lines per the card (full text stays in the DOM). The Quick reference <details> is closed and its body abridged to two paragraphs. Insight bands use the example_insights wording split into body and an n / confidence line; the 'below your normal / holding steady' labels are my own derived words. The blanket tags and the gutter tape overlay the full-bleed rows rather than sit in a separate gutter. KNOWN DEFECTS LEFT AFTER THE ONE FIX ROUND. On mobile the caption 'Illustrative nights; … example cards.' wraps so that 'cards.' sits beside the table-link icon; the pattern H2 is cut off by the sticky ribbon at the bottom of the frame (a scroll-position artifact, but untidy); key labels are 12px on mobile. FLAGS FOR THE OWNER. _data/transparency.yml lists HealthKit WRITE while how_it_works step 1 says 'No writes'; the care label here never prints either claim and must wait for the owner to reconcile them. The distinctness issue file suggests Be Vietnam Pro instead of Familjen Grotesk for this page, because studio-b also uses Familjen; it is not in the card's fixes array, so I kept the card's Familjen and the call is open.
